question: Should OpenClaw accept read-scoped runtime-config drift path names and a per-cache-hit disk snapshot read as part of this gateway health diagnostic?
rationale: The patch is additive and well-proven, but the auth-adjacent visibility boundary and health RPC freshness cost are product/operations tradeoffs that CI cannot settle.

options.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
options.body: Land this PR once maintainers are comfortable with read-scoped drift paths and admin-only fingerprints/errors.

options.title: Request Extra Privacy Or Latency Proof
options.body: Ask for a read-vs-admin transcript or a health latency sample before merge if the boundary or IO cost needs more evidence.

options.title: Pause For Companion Policy PR
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want diagnostics and hot-mode restart behavior to land as one policy bundle.

recommendation.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
recommendation.body: Land this PR once maintainers are comfortable with read-scoped drift paths and admin-only fingerprints/errors.
